description: This Java source file defines the class StartupFrame, which provides a graphical user interface (GUI) window used during the startup process of a rusEfi console application. Its purpose is to allow users to select a serial port or network connection for device communication, initiate connections, and access related firmware flashing and maintenance functionalities. The class manages port detection, UI layout, user interactions, and integrates with other components like firmware flasher and device link management.

classes.name: StartupFrame
classes.description: Class representing the startup window UI for selecting connection interfaces and initiating device communication, including port detection, connection setup, firmware flashing, and diagnostics.

methods.name: StartupFrame
methods.description: Constructor initializing the startup GUI window, setting up port scanning, and handling window events.

methods.name: setAppIcon
methods.description: Static method to set the application icon on a JFrame.

methods.name: chooseSerialPort
methods.description: Sets up the GUI components for port selection, connection, and access to additional tools like firmware flashing.

methods.name: installMessage
methods.description: Utility method to set tooltip text for a UI component.

methods.name: findAndApplyPorts
methods.description: Detects available communication ports and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: findAllAvailablePorts
methods.description: Returns a list of serial and TCP ports currently available for connection.

methods.name: disposeFrameAndProceed
methods.description: Disposes the startup window and stops port scanning when the user proceeds.

methods.name: addPortSelection
methods.description: Populates the port selection dropdown with available ports and sets default selection.

methods.name: createSpeedCombo
methods.description: Creates a dropdown component for selecting baud rates for serial connections.
